content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Upstream natural gas producer and power generator in Texas; it does not distribute propane or fuel oil to households."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Mainly a regulated gas and electric utility with networks and rate-based earnings; its propane sales are a minor, regional side business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Industrial MRO distributor and pump repair provider selling to plants, not fuel delivery to households and businesses."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distributor serving contractors and builders, with no fuel delivery or tank rental business."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Propane distributor delivering to homes and businesses, renting tanks and servicing appliances, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket operator selling groceries and pharmacy goods; its fuel centers are a retail sideline, not a fuel distribution business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Permian midstream operator gathering, processing and transporting gas and liquids for producers and petrochemical buyers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Rents and fabricates natural gas compressors for producers and midstream operators, a different equipment and customer base."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner and retail motor fuel marketer with pipelines; it makes fuel rather than distributing propane and heating oil to households."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures engines and generator sets sold to equipment OEMs; it is an equipment maker, not a fuel distributor."}]}
